panels.description: Database engines discovered by the SQL Server management pack.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT COUNT(*) AS Total,
  COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN g.HealthState = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END),0) AS Healthy,
  COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN g.HealthState = 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END),0) AS Warning,
  COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN g.HealthState = 3 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END),0) AS Critical
FROM dbo.ManagedEntityGenericView g
WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM dbo.ManagedTypeView t WHERE t.Id = g.MonitoringClassId AND t.Name = 'Microsoft.SQLServer.Windows.DBEngine') AND g.IsDeleted = 0
  AND g.DisplayName IN (${sqlengine:singlequote})

panels.description: Rolled-up health of each database engine, health of its SQL Server Agent, and how many databases are monitored.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT TOP 200
  g.DisplayName AS Engine,
  CASE g.HealthState WHEN 1 THEN 'Healthy' WHEN 2 THEN 'Warning' WHEN 3 THEN 'Critical' ELSE 'Not monitored' END AS Health,
  COALESCE((SELECT TOP 1 CASE a.HealthState WHEN 1 THEN 'Healthy' WHEN 2 THEN 'Warning' WHEN 3 THEN 'Critical' ELSE 'Not monitored' END
            FROM dbo.ManagedEntityGenericView a
            WHERE a.Path IS NOT NULL AND CHARINDEX('.', a.Path) > 0 AND a.IsDeleted = 0 AND a.DisplayName LIKE 'SQL Server Agent (%'
              AND LEFT(a.Path, CHARINDEX('.', a.Path) - 1) + '\' + RIGHT(a.Path, CHARINDEX('.', REVERSE(a.Path)) - 1) = g.DisplayName), 'Not monitored') AS "Agent",
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM dbo.ManagedEntityGenericView d
     WHERE d.IsDeleted = 0 AND d.Path IS NOT NULL AND CHARINDEX('.', d.Path) > 0
       AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM dbo.ManagedTypeView t WHERE t.Id = d.MonitoringClassId AND t.Name = 'Microsoft.SQLServer.Windows.Database')
       AND LEFT(d.Path, CHARINDEX('.', d.Path) - 1) + '\' + RIGHT(d.Path, CHARINDEX('.', REVERSE(d.Path)) - 1) = g.DisplayName) AS Databases,
  g.StateLastModified AS LastStateChange
FROM dbo.ManagedEntityGenericView g
WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM dbo.ManagedTypeView t WHERE t.Id = g.MonitoringClassId AND t.Name = 'Microsoft.SQLServer.Windows.DBEngine') AND g.IsDeleted = 0
  AND g.DisplayName IN (${sqlengine:singlequote})
ORDER BY CASE g.HealthState WHEN 3 THEN 0 WHEN 2 THEN 1 WHEN 1 THEN 3 ELSE 2 END, g.DisplayName

panels.title: Instance health (click an instance for detail)

panels.description: Newest sample per counter in the last 3 hours. NO DATA = no sample delivered. Page life expectancy: amber under 1000 s, red under 300 s. Buffer cache hit: amber under 95 %.

targets.rawSql:
WITH x AS (
  SELECT e.DisplayName AS eng, r.CounterName AS c, p.SampleValue AS v, p.DateTime AS t,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY e.DisplayName, r.ObjectName, r.CounterName, i.InstanceName ORDER BY p.DateTime DESC) AS rn
  FROM Perf.vPerfRaw p
  JOIN dbo.vPerformanceRuleInstance i ON i.PerformanceRuleInstanceRowId = p.PerformanceRuleInstanceRowId
  JOIN dbo.vPerformanceRule r ON r.RuleRowId = i.RuleRowId
  JOIN dbo.vManagedEntity e ON e.ManagedEntityRowId = p.ManagedEntityRowId
  WHERE p.DateTime > DATEADD(hour, -3, GETUTCDATE())
    AND e.DisplayName IN (${sqlengine:singlequote})
    AND ( (r.ObjectName = 'SQL DB Engine:General Statistics' AND r.CounterName IN ('User Connections', 'Logins/sec'))
       OR (r.ObjectName = 'SQL DB Engine:Buffer Manager' AND r.CounterName IN ('Page life expectancy', 'Buffer cache hit ratio'))
       OR (r.ObjectName = 'SQL DB Engine:Databases' AND r.CounterName = 'Transactions/sec')
       OR (r.ObjectName = 'SQL DB Engine:Locks' AND r.CounterName IN ('Lock Waits/sec', 'Number of Deadlocks/sec'))
       OR (r.ObjectName = 'SQL DB Engine:SQL Statistics' AND r.CounterName = 'SQL Compilations/sec')
       OR (r.ObjectName = 'SQL DB Engine' AND r.CounterName = 'Stolen Server Memory (MB)') )
)
SELECT eng AS Engine,
  MAX(CASE WHEN c = 'User Connections' THEN v END) AS "User connections",
  MAX(CASE WHEN c = 'Logins/sec' THEN v END) AS "Logins/s",
  MAX(CASE WHEN c = 'Page life expectancy' THEN v END) AS "Page life expectancy (s)",
  MAX(CASE WHEN c = 'Buffer cache hit ratio' THEN v END) AS "Buffer cache hit %",
  MAX(CASE WHEN c = 'Transactions/sec' THEN v END) AS "Transactions/s",
  MAX(CASE WHEN c = 'Lock Waits/sec' THEN v END) AS "Lock waits/s",
  MAX(CASE WHEN c = 'Number of Deadlocks/sec' THEN v END) AS "Deadlocks/s",
  MAX(CASE WHEN c = 'SQL Compilations/sec' THEN v END) AS "Compilations/s",
  MAX(CASE WHEN c = 'Stolen Server Memory (MB)' THEN v END) AS "Stolen memory (MB)",
  MAX(t) AS "Latest sample (UTC)"
FROM x WHERE rn = 1 GROUP BY eng ORDER BY eng

panels.description: Warning / Critical unit monitors on the selected instances and the SQL objects they host.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT DISTINCT TOP 300
  CASE s.HealthState WHEN 3 THEN 'Critical' ELSE 'Warning' END AS Health,
  COALESCE((SELECT TOP 1 m.DisplayName FROM dbo.MonitorView m WHERE m.Id = s.MonitorId AND m.DisplayName IS NOT NULL ORDER BY CASE WHEN m.LanguageCode = 'ENU' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END, m.LanguageCode), s.MonitorName) AS Monitor,
  e.DisplayName AS Object,
  CASE WHEN e.Path IS NULL THEN e.DisplayName WHEN CHARINDEX('.', e.Path) > 0 THEN LEFT(e.Path, CHARINDEX('.', e.Path) - 1) + '\' + RIGHT(e.Path, CHARINDEX('.', REVERSE(e.Path)) - 1) END AS Engine,
  s.LastModified AS Since
FROM dbo.StateView s
JOIN dbo.ManagedEntityGenericView e ON e.Id = s.BaseManagedEntityId
WHERE s.HealthState IN (2, 3)
  AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM dbo.MonitorView m WHERE m.Id = s.MonitorId AND m.IsUnitMonitor = 1)
  AND e.IsDeleted = 0
  AND (e.Path IS NULL OR CHARINDEX('.', e.Path) > 0)
  AND CASE WHEN e.Path IS NULL THEN e.DisplayName WHEN CHARINDEX('.', e.Path) > 0 THEN LEFT(e.Path, CHARINDEX('.', e.Path) - 1) + '\' + RIGHT(e.Path, CHARINDEX('.', REVERSE(e.Path)) - 1) END IN (${sqlengine:singlequote})
  AND (e.Path IS NULL OR e.FullName LIKE 'Microsoft.SQLServer.%')
ORDER BY 1 DESC, 5 DESC

panels.description: Open alerts raised in the selected time range.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT TOP 300
  CASE a.Severity WHEN 2 THEN 'Critical' WHEN 1 THEN 'Warning' ELSE 'Information' END AS Severity,
  COALESCE(NULLIF(a.AlertStringName, ''), a.Name) AS Alert,
  CAST(a.Id AS varchar(36)) AS AlertId,
  a.MonitoringObjectDisplayName AS Source,
  CASE WHEN a.MonitoringObjectPath IS NULL THEN a.MonitoringObjectDisplayName
       WHEN CHARINDEX('.', a.MonitoringObjectPath) > 0 THEN LEFT(a.MonitoringObjectPath, CHARINDEX('.', a.MonitoringObjectPath) - 1) + '\' + RIGHT(a.MonitoringObjectPath, CHARINDEX('.', REVERSE(a.MonitoringObjectPath)) - 1) END AS Engine,
  a.RepeatCount AS Repeats,
  a.TimeRaised AS Raised
FROM (SELECT al.AlertId AS Id, al.AlertName AS Name, al.AlertDescription AS Description, al.BaseManagedEntityId AS MonitoringObjectId, bm.DisplayName AS MonitoringObjectDisplayName, bm.FullName AS MonitoringObjectFullName, bm.Path AS MonitoringObjectPath, bm.TopLevelHostEntityId AS TopLevelHostEntityId, al.IsMonitorAlert, al.RuleId AS MonitoringRuleId, al.ResolutionState, al.Priority, al.Severity, al.Category, al.Owner, al.ResolvedBy, al.TimeRaised, al.LastModified, al.TimeResolved, al.RepeatCount, al.TicketId, al.Context, al.AlertParams, al.CustomField1, al.CustomField2, al.CustomField3, (SELECT TOP 1 lt.LTValue FROM dbo.LocalizedText lt WHERE lt.LTStringId = al.AlertStringId AND lt.LTStringType = 1 ORDER BY CASE WHEN lt.LanguageCode = 'ENU' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END, lt.LanguageCode) AS AlertStringName, (SELECT TOP 1 lt.LTValue FROM dbo.LocalizedText lt WHERE lt.LTStringId = al.AlertStringId AND lt.LTStringType = 2 ORDER BY CASE WHEN lt.LanguageCode = 'ENU' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END, lt.LanguageCode) AS AlertStringDescription FROM dbo.Alert al JOIN dbo.BaseManagedEntity bm ON bm.BaseManagedEntityId = al.BaseManagedEntityId) a
WHERE a.ResolutionState < 255
  AND a.TimeRaised BETWEEN $__timeFrom() AND $__timeTo()
  AND a.MonitoringObjectFullName LIKE 'Microsoft.SQLServer.%'
  AND CASE WHEN a.MonitoringObjectPath IS NULL THEN a.MonitoringObjectDisplayName
           WHEN CHARINDEX('.', a.MonitoringObjectPath) > 0 THEN LEFT(a.MonitoringObjectPath, CHARINDEX('.', a.MonitoringObjectPath) - 1) + '\' + RIGHT(a.MonitoringObjectPath, CHARINDEX('.', REVERSE(a.MonitoringObjectPath)) - 1) END IN (${sqlengine:singlequote})
ORDER BY a.Severity DESC, a.TimeRaised DESC

panels.title: Active SQL alerts

targets.rawSql:
SELECT time, metric, value FROM (
  SELECT DATEADD(minute, (DATEDIFF(minute, 0, p.DateTime) / 5) * 5, 0) AS time,
         e.DisplayName + CASE WHEN i.InstanceName IN ('', '_Total') THEN '' ELSE ' [' + i.InstanceName + ']' END AS metric,
         AVG(p.SampleValue) * 1 AS value
  FROM Perf.vPerfRaw p
  JOIN dbo.vPerformanceRuleInstance i ON i.PerformanceRuleInstanceRowId = p.PerformanceRuleInstanceRowId
  JOIN dbo.vPerformanceRule r ON r.RuleRowId = i.RuleRowId
  JOIN dbo.vManagedEntity e ON e.ManagedEntityRowId = p.ManagedEntityRowId
  WHERE DATEDIFF(minute, $__timeFrom(), $__timeTo()) <= 2880
    AND p.DateTime BETWEEN $__timeFrom() AND $__timeTo()
    AND r.ObjectName = 'SQL DB Engine:General Statistics' AND r.CounterName = 'User Connections'
    AND (i.InstanceName IN ('_Total', '') OR '*' = '*')
    AND e.DisplayName IN (${sqlengine:singlequote})
  GROUP BY DATEADD(minute, (DATEDIFF(minute, 0, p.DateTime) / 5) * 5, 0), e.DisplayName, i.InstanceName
  UNION ALL
  SELECT p.DateTime,
         e.DisplayName + CASE WHEN i.InstanceName IN ('', '_Total') THEN '' ELSE ' [' + i.InstanceName + ']' END,
         AVG(p.AverageValue) * 1
  FROM Perf.vPerfHourly p
  JOIN dbo.vPerformanceRuleInstance i ON i.PerformanceRuleInstanceRowId = p.PerformanceRuleInstanceRowId
  JOIN dbo.vPerformanceRule r ON r.RuleRowId = i.RuleRowId

panels.description: Monitored databases and their current health, worst first.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT TOP 500
  CASE WHEN g.Path IS NULL THEN g.DisplayName WHEN CHARINDEX('.', g.Path) > 0 THEN LEFT(g.Path, CHARINDEX('.', g.Path) - 1) + '\' + RIGHT(g.Path, CHARINDEX('.', REVERSE(g.Path)) - 1) END AS Engine,
  g.DisplayName AS [Database],
  CASE g.HealthState WHEN 1 THEN 'Healthy' WHEN 2 THEN 'Warning' WHEN 3 THEN 'Critical' ELSE 'Not monitored' END AS Health,
  g.StateLastModified AS LastStateChange
FROM dbo.ManagedEntityGenericView g
WHERE g.IsDeleted = 0 AND g.Path IS NOT NULL AND CHARINDEX('.', g.Path) > 0
  AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM dbo.ManagedTypeView t WHERE t.Id = g.MonitoringClassId AND t.Name = 'Microsoft.SQLServer.Windows.Database')
  AND CASE WHEN g.Path IS NULL THEN g.DisplayName WHEN CHARINDEX('.', g.Path) > 0 THEN LEFT(g.Path, CHARINDEX('.', g.Path) - 1) + '\' + RIGHT(g.Path, CHARINDEX('.', REVERSE(g.Path)) - 1) END IN (${sqlengine:singlequote})
ORDER BY CASE g.HealthState WHEN 3 THEN 0 WHEN 2 THEN 1 WHEN 1 THEN 3 ELSE 2 END, 1, 2
